content2.content: Flutter apps typically deal with two main types of notifications: Local and Push.

content4.content: Scheduled by the app itself on the device (e.g., calendar reminder, alarm). Use `flutter_local_notifications`.

content6.content: Sent from a remote server to the device (e.g., chat message, news alert). Use `firebase_messaging`.

content8.content: Local notifications are great for offline scheduling, while push notifications connect your server to the user.
